title: SAMPLED FRAME
rule: one fixed frame, and the whole page is the colour of the screen inside it
description: Seven screens as a log of seven rows beside one fixed frame on a wall. The row at the reading line is current: its screen fills the frame, and the screen's measured hue paints the page. The new screen and its colour arrive together inside one circle that grows from the frame's centre over the wall and the field; then a hairline runs from the row's result to the part of the screen that proves it. Decisions with no screen close the page in a grey record with no hue.
signature: Projector's frame and log with sampled-ground's colour rule. Public Sans for text, Big Shoulders Display for the 96 px row numerals, roles and tray. Palette by construction, only the hue comes from the screen: field oklch(0.95 0.035 h), ink oklch(0.30 0.11 h), wall oklch(0.42 0.13 h); hues measured from each rendered plate (253, 185, 34, 61, 282, 78, 24). Desktop: name-first identity at 40 px and 'Part of two platform rewrites.' over a 520 px log at the left; at the right a full-height wall in the band colour holds a fixed 4:5 frame (576 x 720, never wider, so a store crop is never upscaled), a vertical tray of seven 44 px slots, and the caption with one hue line 'Sampled from the screen: 253°'. Every plate fills the frame: the specimen shows its Tokens and Alert cards whole; care, live room, wallet and reader render in their narrow layouts; bayyinah.org is its public phone view at 0.74x; Viva Fresh is a 576 x 720 native-pixel crop of the App Store cart. Every pin rings a part that proves its result: the One source row (CSS, TypeScript, Figma), the organization switcher (each organization sees only its own patients), the pinned chat message (moderated live chat), the passkey button, the two store badges, the progress row, the Albanian checkout button. Motion: a row becomes current 160 ms after it settles; one clip-path circle (280 ms, ease-out) reveals the new plate and spreads the new hue over wall and field from the frame's centre; the old line fades (120 ms), the result band wipes in (240 ms), the numeral fills (160 ms), and the new line draws (180 ms) with its ring (120 ms). Keys (Up/Down in the log, the tray, Tab) jump with no travel and switch the colour at once. Phone: the wall is the pinned head (4:3 crop of the same part, count, caption, hue); the log scrolls under it. Reduced motion: no circle, no draw, live plates still.
holdback: Lowest: calm, harmony, seniority and original at 8. Calm: the first screen is a split screen with a full-height colour wall, a five-line 40 px identity and a plate with two cards. Harmony: the care pin enters along a lane 12 px under the frame's top edge; the paused live room keeps about 60 px of empty chat under its fourth message, and under reduced motion it shows its full static chat (10 messages) with the first message under the pinned one; the care chart draws once (1.1 s) when its row is first current. Seniority: two results are features a screen can prove (moderated live chat, progress on every book), not outcomes. Original: it is projector's sticky frame with sampled-ground's colour rule; the wall makes it new, the layout is still a frame beside a log. The circle edge cuts glyphs of the plate for about 40 ms during the reveal.

chroma.method: scratchpad/chroma6r.mjs logic (round-3 decode and threshold) on review/loop7/sampled-frame/final/d-top.png (1440 x 900), captured last with every label

hues.method: OKLCH hue histogram, chroma-weighted, 1 degree bins smoothed over 13 degrees, over the rendered 576 x 720 plate at 1440 x 900 with the hairline hidden (review/loop7/sampled-frame/hue.mjs)
